text:
As a customer, I want to retry a payment when the payment gateway times out, without being charged twice.
BR01: Every payment request must include a unique idempotency key for its logical payment; retries reuse that key.
BR02: Reusing the same key with the same payload resolves the original payment and must not create another charge.
BR03: Reusing the same key with a different payment amount is rejected; the original charge and ledger remain unchanged.
BR04: A timeout must not automatically mark the payment as failed. Retain its unresolved outcome until status verification or a callback establishes the result.
BR05: Verify the original payment status before initiating another charge. If already successful, return the original result. If unresolved, do not create a new charge; retain the unresolved outcome until the scripted original success is available.
BR06: Re-delivery of the same successful callback, identified by callback ID and payment ID, must not create another financial ledger posting.
